name: framer
description: Framer's official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.framer.com/mcp, Streamable HTTP). Sign in with your Framer account in the browser (OAuth); no API key, token or env var is stored by this plugin. Read pages and CMS, propose changes, publish only with explicit user OK.
author: Local developer
